$description: Oval design tokens. Colors carry a light and a dark value; everything else is theme-independent. The CSS form of the same tokens is oval.css.

paper.$description: Page background, the color of ballot stock. Dark paper is neutral graphite.

paper-raised.$description: A surface lifted from the page: a card, a callout, a control.

paper-sunken.$description: A surface set into the page: code blocks, wells.

ink.$description: Text, the mark's fill, and anything drawn in ink.

ink-soft.$description: Secondary text: eligibility lines, metadata, captions, placeholders.

mark.$description: The marking purple: the mark's printed ring, link underlines, focus rings, and badges. 5.3:1 on light paper and 6.7:1 on dark, so it may also set small text.

mark-soft.$description: A tint of the marking purple for badge and hover backgrounds.

support.$description: A supported campaign or a yes recommendation.

support-soft.$description: A tint of support for badge backgrounds.

oppose.$description: An opposed campaign or a no recommendation.

oppose-soft.$description: A tint of oppose for badge backgrounds.

display.$description: The wordmark and display-size headings only.

text.$description: Running text, headings, and the wordmark. A variable serif with optical sizes.

mark.fill: 0.65 of the height wide, 0.325 of the height tall, centered
mark.clear-space: half the mark's height on every side
